lines.text: Family heads of the clan of Gilead, from Manasseh, approached Moses about the inheritance of Zelophehad going to his daughters.
They said that if the daughters married men of other tribes, their land would be added to the tribe of Levi.
Moses said at the word of the LORD that the sons of Joseph spoke correctly, and the daughters must marry within their father's tribe.
Mahlah, Tirzah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Rebekah, the daughters of Zelophehad, were married to cousins on their father's side.
Their inheritance stayed within their father's tribe, and the LORD gave these commandments through Moses on the plains of Moab.
